title: MV MV Custom Skill Hit Rate

posts.author: BekoTheWizard
posts.body:
Hello. I'm new to rpg maker. I tried MZ first for a few days but realized plugins are the most cruical part. That's why i decided to go with MV, because everyone said VisuStella plugins are encrypted, which can cause problems during game development and overal inferior to YanFly.
I want to override hit rate formula of the game, spesific for each skill. I found a perfect plugin made by ATT_Turan but it's for MZ.
<hitformula>
your_formula_here
</hitformula>
If this ends with true, you hit. If false, you miss. His plugin overrides the game logic and can work skill-specific. But it's for MZ.
I want the hit rate formula to work this way;
a.agi / b.agi
So, if attacker has 5 agility and target has 10, attacker has a 50% chance to hit. Is it possible to do something like this in MV?

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
VisuStella plugs doesn't impack performance, however, its extremely
hard to modify to make things work.
for MV, Yep plugin you can do similar, I don't know which plugins
are required, battle core engine, and probably the seqpack 1-3.
as I don't know how agility work or % of attack, but in most cases. 0.5 = 50%
where 1 = 100%.
but I cannot help with those lunitic code that require what you want, but its doable.
yanfly has a tip and trick which have many codes, so if one is very close to
what you want, it's easier to modify it.
